name: University of Cambridge
typicalOffer: A*A*A, Mathematics and Further Mathematics (Further Maths A level only); IB Analysis and Approaches; Colleges usually require A* in Maths and/or Further Maths, sometimes A*/7 in Physics
notes: Mathematics Tripos Part II/III Applied Mathematics pathway; DAMTP is the world's leading applied mathematics department; covers fluid mechanics, quantum mechanics, GR

name: University of Oxford
typicalOffer: A*A*A, A* in Mathematics and Further Mathematics (if available); if Further Maths unavailable: A*AAa with A* in Maths and a in AS Further Maths, or A*AA with A* in Maths
notes: Mathematics MMath with Applied Mathematics specialisation in Years 3-4; Mathematical Institute; covers PDEs, fluid dynamics and mathematical biology
courseName: Mathematics / Mathematics and Statistics MMath or BA

name: University of Edinburgh
typicalOffer: A*A*A*-A*AB, including Mathematics at A* (Further Mathematics preferred)
notes: 4-year BSc (Hons) Applied Mathematics; Maxwell Institute; strong in geophysics, continuum mechanics and numerical methods; Scottish 4-year Honours

name: University of Birmingham
typicalOffer: A*A*A or A*AAA, A*A*A with A* Maths and A* Physics, or A*A*A with A* Maths + A*/A Physics + A*/A Further Maths, or A*AAA with A* Maths and A Physics
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.
courseName: Theoretical Physics and Applied Mathematics MSci
